grouped_uncertainty.scope: Descriptive conditional 95% percentile intervals on the previously inspected assessment. Components, rather than crops, are resampled jointly. Fixed models/seeds are not resampled. No post-selection correction, fresh-test claim or deployment guarantee.

acceptance.scope: Descriptive crop-weighted regression score with frozen policy; not the independent-component bound or a future accuracy guarantee.

temperature_fit.method: deterministic bounded golden-section log-temperature search, with T=1 guard
temperature_fit.scope: Fitted and described on calibration data only; in-sample NLL is not test calibration quality.

threshold_selection.no_eligible_rule: Review every prediction explicitly, including confidence exactly1.0; never lower target or silently activate empirical diagnostic.
threshold_selection.method: fixed-grid one-sided exact binomial error upper bounds with Bonferroni family-wise correction
threshold_selection.scope: Under fixed-model/independent-representative assumptions, simultaneous bounds support adaptive choice among this finite grid. Not a crop-weighted or distribution-shift guarantee.

partition.grouping: union of source_group_id and available evaluation_group_id
partition.representative_rule: minimum seeded hash of stable record identity, chosen before logits or labels
partition.scope: Metadata-only split of existing calibration data; no new assessment data and no claim that components are proven independent.

threshold_all_crop_diagnostic.scope: Descriptive crop-weighted statistics on the same threshold partition; not the statistical target population or an independent test.

assumptions: Model and finite threshold grid fixed independently of threshold-selection labels.
Threshold representatives are independent identically distributed draws from the declared component-representative population.
Future inputs follow that same representative population; source-group independence and deployment stationarity are not established by hashes.
limitations: One representative per source/duplicate component avoids treating correlated crops as independent Bernoulli trials; it changes the target population from all crops.
The original calibration set was inspected historically. This split improves separation but does not manufacture fresh calibration data or an unconditional guarantee.
If no threshold satisfies the corrected bound, every prediction requires review; study completion is still possible without target certification.
The existing327-case assessment is not used here and remains a previously inspected descriptive/regression set for subsequent model upgrades.

acceptance.scope: Descriptive crop-weighted regression score with frozen policy; not the independent-component bound or a future accuracy guarantee.

data.scope: Cached data integrity, nonempty class support and source-group separation; not legal clearance or independent garment identity.

deployment_guard.scope: Preset seed selection-only regression guard; no assessment or calibration inference

quality.scope: Selection-only quality criteria and fixed-seed fallback; no assessment-driven choice.

calibration.scope: Valid disjoint calibration fit and explicit review policy. Review-all is technically valid even when no risk threshold qualifies; passing this gate is not a95% accuracy guarantee.

parity.scope: CPU FP32 tensor-logit parity after choices frozen; no assessment-driven model selection.

png_predictor.scope: PNG encoding of prepared 224px crops through actual decode/crop/preprocess/Predictor; no arbitrary-photo quality claim.

http_contract.scope: In-process HTTP ASGI contract with actual Predictor; no network deployment, uptime or production traffic.

serving.scope: Actual local CPU Predictor and in-process HTTP contracts on recorded prepared crops. No public deployment or arbitrary-photo validation.

limitations: The original assessment327 was inspected before this upgrade; all new scores on it are exploratory regression evidence.
Group-representative binomial bounds are conditional on stated independence/population assumptions and do not guarantee crop-weighted95% accuracy.
Data size, six-label scope and manual-crop requirements are unchanged. No smartphone-photo or production validation is asserted.
A review-all policy is valid but provides zero autonomous coverage. Training-seed SD is not uncertainty over independent datasets.
